field.label: Enable
field.help: Publish the sites of the Sites tab through this firewall: each request is received here, inspected by ModSecurity with the OWASP Core Rule Set, and passed to the site's backend. Off by default. A new site only logs what the rules find, until its Mode is Blocking.

field.label: Listen interfaces
field.help: The interfaces whose addresses the sites are received on. None chosen: every address of this firewall. A site reached from another network also needs a rule on that interface passing its port to This Firewall (Firewall: Rules): none is made here.

field.label: HTTP port
field.help: The port of the sites without a certificate, and of the redirect to HTTPS of those with one: 80 by default. Empty: no plain HTTP. A port the web GUI listens on where the sites would be received is refused: move the GUI in System: Settings: Administration - another TCP port, or Listen interfaces other than the ones chosen here.

field.label: HTTPS port
field.help: The port of the sites with a certificate: 443 by default. Empty: no HTTPS. The web GUI listens on 443 of every interface until it is moved, as for the HTTP port.
